summary: Reconcile conflicting message operation receipts without replaying the whole graph

replay.detail: A message.sent claim whose operation digest differs or whose receipt is already conflict now canonically repairs only that operation in the incremental projection transaction. Other claim kinds retain their existing operation-conflict full replay guard. Startup does not require a new migration replay; a deferred message-only conflict backlog advances with the committed receipt repair.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger, claim or signature changes. Uses the existing indexed operation reducer and operations row.

rules.detail: Canonical minimum digest/claim selection, conflict outcomes, checkpoint tombstone participation and repaired-claim exclusions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No registry, wire or client change. Signed claims remain untouched; idempotency mismatch/conflict refusals retain their meaning.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only. No fleet coordination or extra service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No live replay, heal, reset, database edit or member restart is requested by this change.

recovery.detail: Older binaries read unchanged canonical rows and resume their former full-replay guard. No irreversible format or outcome change.
